headline: HOU @ TEX matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is HOU 3.41 at TEX 4.12, with a projected total of 7.54. Movement read: NRFI probability rose +5.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Batter research is strongest for Jake Burger, Justin Foscue, Isaac Paredes, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Zach Cole, Andrew McCutchen because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
